findings.title: SQL injection: name parameter is formatted straight into the query string
OS command injection: host parameter is concatenated into a /bin/sh -c command
Path traversal: file parameter is appended to the docs path without validation
Reflected XSS: name parameter is put into the HTML response without escaping
XXE: NSXMLParser resolves external entities in user-supplied XML
Insecure deserialization: user data is passed to NSKeyedUnarchiver without secure coding
Open redirect: the next parameter is used as the Location header unchecked
HTTP response splitting: percent-decoded CRLF characters reach the Location header
Predictable reset token from rand() seeded with the current time
SSRF: the server fetches any user-supplied URL
Format string vulnerability: user input is used as the format string
